The video-only and video+recall-without-annotations cases (AC3's "supported configured source-perception route") consume the package produced by "[media] Video-only source package: raw video to a checked timed source with media receipts". That bead is not a blocker here: text and annotation preparation land first, and the video case returns the actionable missing-capability result until the package exists, then accepts it as a supplied checked source package (AC3). If normalized annotations must be persisted as a checked input artifact (AC3, AC5), the emission ADR bd-01M2WTQ5PNB7RJ6NEAAAYCHYRY becomes this bead's prerequisite.
